mapper.insert: insert into mcp_tool_schema ( gateway_id, tool_id, schema_version, input_schema, output_schema, schema_hash, is_active, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{gatewayId}, #{toolId}, #{schemaVersion}, #{inputSchema}, #{outputSchema}, #{schemaHash}, #{isActive}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update mcp_tool_schema set gateway_id = #{gatewayId}, tool_id = #{toolId}, schema_version = #{schemaVersion}, input_schema = #{inputSchema}, output_schema = #{outputSchema}, schema_hash = #{schemaHash}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, gateway_id, tool_id, schema_version, input_schema, output_schema, schema_hash, is_active, created_at, updated_at from mcp_tool_schema where 1 = 1 and gateway_id = #{gatewayId} and tool_id = #{toolId} and is_active = 1 order by schema_version desc limit 1
